wireContract: A video submission snapshot may report intent song_reference, and a blocked snapshot's reason_code may be song_reference_invalid, with an optional song_reason_code (song_not_published, song_audio_revision_missing, derivative_video_blocked or derivative_video_owner_only) naming why the referenced song can no longer be used. The public video projection's song_reference soundtrack now carries render_mode canonical_replace. The added enum value is breaking under Spec 000 section 5 and is covered by ten waivers the workspace_owner approved on 2026-09-10 against baseline 4335629e. Only song-reference submissions, which stay disabled, can produce it; this client must ship before they are enabled.

verification.status: Focused contract, application, PostgreSQL and composed song-video regressions passed locally; the full required gates and release are pending. Version 0.70.0 may collide with another lane cutting a release concurrently; whichever lands second takes the next version.
